extractions.description: The paper introduces Double Gumbel Q-Learning, a Deep Q-Learning algorithm for both discrete and continuous control, addressing heteroscedastic Gumbel noise sources in Deep Neural Networks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on improving the efficiency and stability of Q-learning algorithms, a type of reinforcement learning, but does not directly address or focus on sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We show that Deep Neural Networks introduce two heteroscedastic Gumbel noise sources into Q-Learning. To account for these noise sources, we propose Double Gumbel Q-Learning, a Deep Q-Learning algorithm applicable for both discrete and continuous control.
